grade.description: Signature grade screen thresholds enforced by scripts/validate_image_grade.py (Items 8 and 9). Every threshold is a floor: a generated image measuring below it FAILS the screen. A threshold set to null is UNCALIBRATED: the screen prints that metric's measurements as WARN and applies no gate for it, and the production gate refuses to close image-generation-qc for a non-test run while min_mean_saturation or min_luma_std is null (Item 8 close rule). Thresholds are never invented: they are derived by scripts/calibrate_grade.py from Trevor's approved gold set (assets/brand/gold-set/, floor = gold-set 5th percentile x 0.95), printed as a proposal, and written into the brand file only after Trevor approves or adjusts them. Two further checks in the screen are unconditional and need no threshold: near-duplicate detection (8x8 average hash, Hamming distance 4 or less fails unless the pair is declared in the inventory's continuity_group) and aspect-ratio truth against inventory slots (2 percent tolerance).

block_file.description: Path to the Signature Grade Block text the prompt validator requires verbatim on sauce-only pages.

min_mean_saturation.description: Floor for mean HSV saturation (0-1) over the image's 256px working copy. Null = uncalibrated.

min_luma_std.description: Floor for the standard deviation of luminance (0-255 scale). Null = uncalibrated.

min_sharpness.description: Item 9: floor for sharpness, the variance of Pillow FIND_EDGES over the grayscale 256px working copy. Optional key: absent is treated exactly like null (uncalibrated, WARN only) until Item 8's calibration procedure is extended to it and Trevor approves the number.

min_colorfulness.description: Item 9: floor for the Hasler-Susstrunk colorfulness metric over the rg/yb opponent channels of the 256px working copy. Optional key: absent is treated exactly like null (uncalibrated, WARN only) until calibrated and owner-approved like the other floors.

calibration.description: Item 8 calibration record. Written by hand, once, when Trevor approves proposed floors and they are entered into this grade block; scripts never write it (calibrate_grade.py proposes only). Absent while thresholds are uncalibrated.

date.description: Date Trevor approved the floors, ISO format.

gold_set_manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of assets/brand/gold-set/gold-set.json as it stood at calibration time, so a later gold-set change is detectable against the floors it produced.

approved_by.description: Who approved the floors (Trevor Otts for the BlackCEO brand).

note.description: Optional: adjustments Trevor made to the proposed floors and why.
